prompt: A minimal flat line icon, centred, seen straight on: a stopwatch: one large hollow circle with a short stem and a small flat cap on top, and inside the circle a single straight hand pointing up and to the right from the centre. The background is perfectly flat, plain, uniform off-white #fbfcfd paper with no gradient, no texture and no shadow. No photographic rendering, no glow, no 3D, no perspective, no second colour, no thin lines, no extra details, no ornaments, no text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no border, no frame. Palette strictly limited to ink grey #13212b on off-white #fbfcfd.
